Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO₂), mild metabolic acidosis (low arterial pH), leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, monocytosis and basophilia, and low total protein with high albumin. These findings may indicate acute or chronic hypoxic respiratory failure, possible infection or bone marrow suppression, and possible protein loss or malnutrition. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
